decks.notes: This deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal spells, and efficient creatures. The key strategy is to stall the opponent's advances with Counterspell and Prismatic Strands, while using cards like Journey to Nowhere and Guardian of the Guildpact to remove threats. Squadron Hawk provides card advantage, while Sacred Cat and Dawnbringer Cleric help stabilize the board. The Gates also provide mana fixing and card advantage with cards like The Modern Age and Citadel Gate. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantages.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using spells like Counterspell and Ephemerate to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also utilizes cards like Mulldrifter and Augur of Bolas to draw cards and maintain card advantage. The deck includes a land destruction package with cards like Cleansing Wildfire and Skred, while also including some creature removal with Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by generating card advantage through card draw and recursion with cards like Archaeomancer.

The focal point of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small, efficient white creatures, also known as weenies. By quickly establishing a board presence and continuously pressuring the opponent with low-cost creatures, this aggro deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent before they can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Prismatic Strands and Journey to Nowhere provide utility and disruption, while cards like Guardians' Pledge and Battle Screech offer ways to pump up the team and close out games efficiently.

The main concept of the deck is to control the game through card advantage and removal spells, while also utilizing cheap counterspells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck is focused on tempo plays and efficient removal, with the goal of maintaining control of the board and outlasting the opponent. It includes a mix of card draw, counterspells, and removal to help stabilize the board and protect key threats. The inclusion of snow-covered lands allows for access to powerful snow synergies while also enabling cards like Skred to function effectively.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells and removal spells. The deck aims to quickly fill up its graveyard with cards like Mental Note and Thought Scour to enable the casting of powerful spells like Gurmag Angler and Deep Analysis. The deck also utilizes card draw from Brainstorm and Tolarian Terror to maintain card advantage. With a mix of creature removal, counterspells, and card draw, this Dimir Control deck aims to outvalue and outlast its opponent in a one-on-one Pauper match.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly flood the board with cheap artifact creatures and use them to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive attacks. The deck focuses on playing efficient creatures like Myr Enforcer and Frogmite alongside artifact synergy cards like Ichor Wellspring and Thoughtcast to maintain card advantage and keep the pressure on the opponent. It also includes removal spells like Galvanic Blast and Nihil Spellbomb to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to swarm the board with artifacts and creatures while leveraging their abilities and synergy to secure a quick victory.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan while efficiently drawing cards and utilizing graveyard resources. The deck includes a mixture of counterspells, removal spells, card draw, and graveyard recursion to maintain control of the game. By using cards like Mental Note and Thought Scour to fill the graveyard, the deck can easily cast powerful threats like Gurmag Angler. The goal is to outvalue the opponent and grind them out with efficient control spells and card advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with aggressive, low-cost creatures and burn spells. By using cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Blast-Runner alongside cheap burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, the deck aims to deal damage to the opponent early and often. Cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Experimental Synthesizer provide additional creatures to apply pressure, while Wrenn's Resolve protects your creatures from removal spells. The goal is to be proactive and push through damage efficiently to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using Golgari/Jund Garden lands to generate value through enter the battlefield triggers and sacrificing creatures. This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with removal spells like Cast Down and Crypt Rats while also generating card advantage with cards like Ichor Wellspring and Deadly Dispute. The deck also utilizes creatures like Avenging Hunter and Thorn of the Black Rose to put pressure on the opponent. Overall, the goal is to outvalue the opponent and control the game until victory.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cheap creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Bushwhacker, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Cards like Mutagenic Growth and Voldaren Epicure provide additional ways to buff creatures and pressure the opponent. The goal is to finish the game before the opponent can stabilize or mount a significant defense.

The main focus of the deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Wild Growth and Utopia Sprawl, allowing for explosive plays in the early game. It also includes land destruction spells like Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The creatures like Arbor Elf, Llanowar Visionary, Boarding Party, Annoyed Altisaur, Avenging Hunter, and Generous Ent are all aggressive threats that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. Overall, the goal of this Gruul Aggro deck is to apply pressure early and continue to push the tempo throughout the game.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while efficiently using card draw and removal spells to control the board. The deck aims to stall the game by countering spells, removing threats, and eventually overwhelming opponents with powerful threats like Gurmag Angler. By utilizing efficient card draw spells like Brainstorm and Deep Analysis, the deck is able to refill its hand and maintain control throughout the game. This deck excels at outmaneuvering opponents and grinding out victories through smart decision-making and resource management.

The deck is focused on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of counter spells and removal cards. It also aims to manipulate its own deck by drawing cards and filling the graveyard to fuel powerful spells like Gurmag Angler. The deck includes cards that provide card advantage, protection, and disruption, allowing the player to control the pace of the game and outvalue the opponent. Additionally, the deck features a mix of creatures and spells to provide a diverse threat base and keep the opponent on their toes.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using countermagic, removal spells, and value creatures like Mulldrifter and Sea Gate Oracle. The deck also utilizes the blinking effect of Ephemerate to generate additional value from creatures like Archaeomancer and Dawnbringer Cleric. Additionally, it includes land destruction with cards like Cleansing Wildfire and Cast into the Fire to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent while maintaining control of the game.

The deck focuses on generating value through sacrificing creatures and using removal spells to control the board. It aims to grind out the opponent with efficient removal spells like Defile and Cast Down, while also utilizing cards like Innocent Blood and Chainer's Edict to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes card draw options like Ichor Wellspring and Reckoner's Bargain to maintain card advantage. Additionally, the inclusion of Crypt Rats and Avenging Hunter give the deck a strong late game finisher.

The focus of this UR Control deck is to utilize efficient counterspells and removal spells to control the game while maintaining card advantage through card draw spells and creature recursion. The deck aims to stall the opponent's game plan by countering threats and removing key cards, all while deploying evasive creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Spellstutter Sprite to pressure the opponent. The inclusion of snow lands enables strong removal spells like Skred, making it a resilient and adaptable deck that can handle a variety of matchups in a Pauper 1 vs 1 format.
